title: Velora battery warranty (v2025)
text:
The traction battery supplied with a Velora bicycle is covered for 24 months from the
date of delivery, or 500 full charge cycles, whichever limit is reached first. Cycle
count is read from the battery management system at the point of claim.

title: Velora battery warranty (v2025)
text:
Coverage does not extend to damage from immersion, from charging with a non-Velora
charger, or from physical impact. A pack whose cycle count exceeds 500 is outside
coverage regardless of elapsed time.

title: Velora returns policy
text:
Bicycles may be returned within 30 days of delivery. Accessories may be returned within
14 days of delivery. Both windows run from delivery, not from despatch. The statutory
14-day withdrawal period applies in addition and is never shortened by this policy.

title: Velora returns policy
text:
Return carriage on a bicycle is borne by Velora where the return is made inside the
30-day window and the bicycle is in resalable condition. Carriage on an accessory
return is borne by the customer.

title: Supplier framework agreement
text:
Lead time is 45 days from purchase order to delivery at the European warehouse. An
inbound quality control step of 5 days follows receipt, before stock is released as
sellable. End-to-end planning therefore uses 50 days.

title: Range profitability method
text:
Commercial margin is assessed against landed cost, not trade cost. Landed cost per unit
is trade cost plus inbound freight, plus duty, plus the inbound quality control charge.
Quoting a margin against trade cost overstates it.

title: Range profitability method
text:
Orders in status `returned`, `refunded` or `cancelled` are excluded from net revenue.
Orders in status `processing` have not shipped and are excluded from any period figure
that describes what was sold.

title: Group reporting policy
text:
Non-euro sales are translated at the monthly average reference rate for the month of the
order. The payment provider's spread is booked as a separate cost line and does not
adjust the translated revenue figure.

title: Warranty registry
text:
The warranty registry covers serialised bicycles from model year 2024 onward. Cycle
counts are not held in the registry. Accessories are not serialised and are not
represented in the registry.

title: Support playbook
text:
A claim that turns on a cycle count must be escalated to technical support, because the
count is read from the battery management system and is not available to first-line
agents from any record they can see.
